purpose: Independent genomic-assay validation of the revised individual-covariance workflow, conditional on the unchanged recorded ecological histories and sampled adults.
authority: Adjust/update to make this a valid vignette dataset
run_only_after: All original ecology/source/roster checks remain valid, the ordinary-model main gates pass, and the wide-guard identification audit agrees. These validation markers cannot replace the main data or tune a model.

ancestry.method: The exact original recorded pedigree, new independent Mendelian segregation in each synthetic block, then the unchanged panmictic ancient-ancestry assumption. No SLiM ecological rerun or altered biological parameter.

markers.selection: Position-spread selection from all eligible sites in twenty predetermined blocks. No landscape-association filtering. A shortage fails the stage without adding blocks, changing filters or replacing a seed.
markers.microsatellites: 24 matched bounded-stepwise loci, mutation rate 1e-4, states 5-45 and root state 20, at fixed positions from 51 Mb through 99 Mb across the new synthetic blocks. All loci, including monomorphic loci, are retained.

sample_ids: The exact original ordered 160 individuals in each case; no new sampling.
randomness: Base 90401, SHA256-derived case/stage/block seeds in the namespace terradish-year500-validation-blocks-20261023. Freeze all 160 recent/recap/SNP/msat seeds before generation; no replacement draws.
evaluation: Use the already frozen ordinary-model uniform and IBR fits, including their variance/nuisance parameters. Do not fit any parameter to validation markers. Score new-marker covariance and squared distances for all 160 adults and each 40-individual held-out quadrant. The individual folds are reused, but these genomic blocks were not involved in workflow development.
interpretation: Independent segregation and mutation conditional on the same pedigree are an assay check, not independent ecological replication. Marker discovery remains conditional on the frozen complete sample.
pre_generation_design_revision: The initial six-block 1000-SNP proposal was not executed. Before any validation genotype was generated, it was replaced by an assay matching the original 20 blocks, 2500 SNPs and 24 microsatellites so marker-panel size does not confound the comparison. Preserve the unexecuted proposal.
